Our treatment is pure Ayurvedic and free from side effects and helps to remove the side effects of the medicines that you have taken earlier.  This is cost effective too.

The treatment includes   Panchakarma therapy (Abhyangam (massage) with specially prepared Ayurvedic oil, Elakizhi, Njavarakizhi, Snehanam, Swedanam (medicated steam bath), Virechanam (medicated purgation), specially prepared herbal paste (lepam) for external application and internal medicines etc… according to the patient’s medical condition.  You can go to our testimonials page, where you can see the patients have written or told their experience with name and address, (photo if available). Some of them may be known to you or you may have some close friend of them. You may enquire them personally. A complete blood investigation before and after the treatment will help you to evaluate the treatment, and gives you more satisfaction.

Kindly bring or send your test reports [blood tests { uric acid, C-reactive protein (CRP), erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR) etc…}, x-rays, C.T, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scan.] to our mail ID for evaluating the prognosis of the disease (test reports if available).

We use internal and external medicines which are manufactured in our own Medicine Manufacturing unit, having GMP Certificate. Benefits of our Treatment:

  3. Our treatment helps to regain the flexibility of the body.
  4. Our medications for   Gout will help to remove toxins, inflammation, stiffness, bulging etc…
  5. Our treatment helps to increase the blood supply to the affected parts and the cells will get more oxygen and nutrients and this helps to rebuild the degenerated parts and stops further degeneration.
  6. There is no risky operation and it is 100% safe and protects you from other ailments too.

 

What is Gout?

Gout is a kind of arthritis. Gout is caused by high level of uric acid in the blood. When uric acid levels in your blood are too high, the uric acid may form hard crystals in your joints. It can cause an attack of sudden burning pain, stiffness, and swelling in a joint, usually a big toe. These attacks can happen over and over unless gout is treated. Over time, they can harm your joints, tendons, and other tissues. The most common sign of gout is a nighttime attack of swelling, tenderness, redness, and sharp pain in your big toe. You can also get gout attacks in your foot, ankle, or knees, or other joints. The attacks can last a few days or many weeks before the pain goes away. Another attack may not happen for months or years. Gout is most common in men. Your chances of getting gout are higher if you are alcoholic, overweight, or eat too much meat and fish that are high in chemicals called purines. Some medicines such as diuretics can also bring on gout.
